tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma thugs rje can/ /mgon gcig chog rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems gnas lugs rjen par rtogs pa dang*/ /pha khyed kyi thugs dang mnyam par shog /brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen/ / skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla ma dam pa/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi yi dam lha tshogs/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig / bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /bar chad kun sel gyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong*/ /dam tshig rjes dran gyi rdo rje spun grogs/ /rtag tu byams pa ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig / bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras bcas kyi ngo bo/ /lung rtogs dam chos ma lus pa'i gter mdzod/ /'phags tshogs 'dus pa kun 'dus kyi gtso bo/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig / bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /spros bral mkha' khyab rang rig gi chos sku/ /bde stong dbyer med kyi rang gsal longs sku/ /gang 'dul thugs rje mkha' khyab kyi sprul sku/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun du thugs rjes gzigs shig / bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' yas/ /nye ring mi mnga' brtse ba'i klong yangs/ /'phrin las mtha' med nus mthu'i bdag po/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun du thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig

/dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /bde skyid kun stsol dpag bsam gyi shing chen/ /rgyun chad med pa gzhan phan gyi chu bo/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /'phongs bskyab kun sel gter chen gyi bum bzang*/ /srid gsum mun sel gyi rdo rje nyi ma/ /nyon mongs gdung sel gyi rgyu skar bdag po/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /brtan g.yo kun khyab kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ /bde chen 'gyur med kyi lhan cig skyes dga'/ /rang rtsal 'gyur med kyi rnam pa kun ldan/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /bdag sems ma bcos so ma'i rig pa/ khams gsum snang srid dran rtog gi 'char sgo/ /thams cad khyed thugs 'od gsal du ro mnyam/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas gcig pu/ /'gro kun bde la 'god mdzad khyod nyid/ /skyob pa bla med 'dren mchog chos rje/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ / rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi sems can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ma rgan sems can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'khor bar gtan 'khyams byed la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'khrul pa'i 'khor lo bskor la thugs rjes gzigs/

/gdeng med rtag rtsis can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sdug bsngal g.yos sbyor mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dad med pho tshod mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang sems gnas lugs ma rtogs pa la gzigs su gsol/ /nyon mongs rang gar shor ba rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /rig pa phyir ltas shor ba rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /chos med bzang rdzun shor ba rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /blo rgod gyong bo thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhen med nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yid ches dad pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /le lo rnam g.yeng sangs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon mongs ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun smin grol la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes pa'ang nam mkha' brtson 'grus kyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // bla ma rgyang 'bod bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
